Catalyst.description: A catalyst formulation as its source names it ("Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 44:36:20 wt", "zinc chromite"). Its make-up is HAS_COMPONENT edges to species and materials, each with its role (active phase, support, promoter, binder, dopant) and fraction; its phases are HAS_PHASE; physical specimens are CatalystSamples (HAS_FORMULATION). Declared conditions and results are properties; others go in the inherited conditions and results maps. Driving-force properties (potential, irradiance, discharge power) come from the vocabulary of their driving force. A reported equilibrium estimate is a CatalyticTest with test_kind equilibrium_estimate and experiment_kind computational.

scope: Cutoff: published or publicly disclosed before 1966-01-01. ICI launched low-pressure methanol synthesis over Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 in 1966 (GB 1,010,871, published 1966; US 3,326,956); a cutoff of 1 January 1966 holds out that commercialization and what followed as rediscovery targets, and admits everything published before it, ICI's earlier publications included. The cutoff does not remove every Cu-Zn-Al disclosure: the corpus leakage audit (historical/LEAKAGE_AUDIT.md) lists US 2,061,470 (Larson, granted 1936), whose Example 10 is 87 CuO / 10 ZnO / 3 Al2O3, and Cu-Zn catalysts from 1928 on. They are in scope and curated as reported; a rediscovery evaluation must hold them out separately if it needs to. Each source was read and curated from its page texts (PDF text layer, or Tesseract OCR where the PDF has none); every quote is checked verbatim against those texts.
